notes: Encoded ONLY from Lochinvar's own page. No content imported from any related page (Crest, Copper-Fin, Copper-Fin II, EnergyRite, FTXL): where systems coincide, each style below is justified from this page's own text and examples independently, and this file does not change those already-shipped files. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 1 (KJ-1000130: year = 1st letter, month = 2nd letter, both chart-only) and page Style 7 (5Y013 / 6S1064 / 11AA0365: year = 2nd or 2nd & 3rd letters, chart-only) — no year encodable from text. Page Styles 3, 4, 5, 6 ship YEAR-ONLY: year digits text-verified, month = 1st letter chart-only. Page Style 5: only the single form stated on this page (list and section agree: J 93-1030F) is encoded — unlike Crest/Copper, no dual-form encoding, since no second form appears in this page's text. Page Style 9 ships from this page (1984-present, 8-digit year+month); it was deliberately NOT imported into Crest/Copper because it is absent from their 2017 pages.
